findings.note: NO ROW - the fix needs a reader that does not exist, and authoring the data half alone would ship the WG defect the finding refutes. The heightening must fire only for a member of the Order of the Gate. The order IS recorded: feats/hellknight-dedication carries a `choice` with flag `hellknightOrder` whose value is `order-of-the-gate` (effect-backfill row index 6268), and src/rules/build.ts:1969 `choiceFlagAnswer` can read it. What is missing is a predicate that gates a grant on ANOTHER record's flag: `InnateSpellGrant.whenChoice` is the record's OWN choice (here the tradition pick), `EffectChoiceOption.onlyWhenFlag` only filters options out of a picker and passes an UNANSWERED flag through, and `effectChoiceOffered`'s `requiresChoice` is same-record only. Grepped `requiresFlag` / `whenFlag` / `requiresChoiceFlag` across src/rules - nothing. Writing `heightenAt:[{level:14,rank:5}]` on the four tradition options without that gate is exactly WG's encoding (rank 5 at 14 for everyone), which this finding CONFIRMS as wrong. Row and reader both listed in the report.

NO ROW - the picker is built in CODE, not from core.json. The 38-cantrip list comes from src/builder/shared.tsx:3902 (`Object.values(content.spells).filter(s => s.rank === 0 && s.traditions.includes(trad))`) and src/builder/Builder.tsx:971 (`spellIndex.cantrips[tradition]`), both driven by `CASTER_ARCHETYPES['oatia-skysage-dedication']` in src/rules/casterArchetypes.ts:304. `CasterArchetype` carries no field naming which cantrips are allowed - its own header comment says so outright ("nothing here restricts WHICH cantrips may be prepared from it") - and `SpellcastingGrant` has none either. No core.json field can express the restriction today, so there is no durable overlay row to write; see CROSS-FILE GAPS.

The resonant clause is re-emitted WHOLE (one field, `resonant`) with a new `spellNotes` member carrying the same printed sentence keyed to the spell the stone grants. `resonant` is the existing lane and is already gated exactly as the ruling asks - src/rules/build.ts:8088 fires it only on `inv.invested && inv.designations?.includes('wayfinder-slotted')` - so hanging the note there inherits the 'Slotted in a wayfinder' mark and needs no second control. WG's yes/no picker is deliberately NOT added. The stone's own top-level `spellNotes` was NOT used: that lane (build.ts:6843) fires for any worn/invested item with no designation check, which would print the resonant sentence on a stone orbiting your head. ⚠ NO READER YET for `resonant.spellNotes` - the 3-line teach is in CROSS-FILE GAPS. SUPERSEDES the existing `resonant` row; its `note` is carried through byte-for-byte.

findings.note: Three rows, no mechanical row at all. The import rewrote the printed spell name Dancing Lights to Light inside the stored text and left a descRefs link pointing at spells/Light; our Light is the Remaster cantrip and none of this feat's modification is true of it, so the rewrite put a false rule on a real spell while the feat's display still read "dancing lights" in its prerequisites. Row 1 restores the printed name (verified verbatim against the mirror, feat-3375) and changes NOTHING ELSE in the printed text. Row 2 carries the one line marked as ours on the record's own `note` field, NOT inside the description: `note` is the app's own-voice lane (87 feats already use it) and it renders on a built character as "**Note:** ..." under the feat entry, src/sheet/FeatsTab.tsx:131. Authoring the line inside `description` was refused by the batch driver's pre-check (5) (scripts/wg-batch-run.mjs:682-694), which allows a description row only tokens that are in our current text or in the cited mirror doc - correctly, since a description row is supposed to carry PRINT, and this line is ours. Row 3 empties the descRefs link. `[]`, not null: a removal row for a prose field cannot be replayed - apply-backfill-now.mjs routes a descRefs row to core-descriptions.json only when `Array.isArray(value)` (scripts/apply-backfill-now.mjs:72), so a null row reaches neither file and the apply stage's post-check refuses the whole batch ("removal row (value:null) and the field is still present in the shipped artefact"). An empty array routes, survives split-descriptions.mjs (`if (r)` - [] is truthy), and is equivalent to absent for every reader, all of which test `descRefs?.length` or map over it. Deliberately NO spellNote and no rider on spells/light, per the ruling. No spellNote on Dancing Lights either: we ship no `dancing-lights` record, and `pushSpellNote` (src/rules/build.ts:6837) drops a note whose spell does not exist, so it would render nowhere.

value.note: When you cast Black Tentacles, replace the spell's standard effects with the following: Tentacles slither along the ground in the area, attempting to hinder anyone within. Sticky black tentacles attempt to Trip each creature in the area. Attempt spell attack rolls against the Reflex DCs of each affected creature. Any creature you succeed against is knocked prone and takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. Whenever a creature ends its turn in the area, the tentacles attempt to Trip that creature if it isn't already prone, and they deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage to any creature already prone. Creatures treat the spell's area as difficult terrain.
